x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

TermijnRegeling.title: TermijnRegeling
TermijnRegeling.description: A term rule per body-role: term length (termijnDuurMaanden) and an optional maximum number of consecutive terms (maxAansluitendeTermijnen), from which term numbers and end-of-term dates are DERIVED per Membership (never written onto Membership, design D2). At most one regeling is effective per body-role combination, and a role-specific regeling overrides the body-wide one; this uniqueness/override rule is NOT expressible in the schema (no unique-constraint dialect) and is enforced at save time by the imperative layer. An empty role means the rule applies to all roles in the body.

body.title: Governance body
body.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this term rule applies to. Required.

role.title: Role
role.description: Membership role the rule applies to (enum pinned to person-and-membership). Optional: empty means the rule applies to all roles in the body; a role-specific regeling overrides the body-wide one.

termDurationMonths.title: Term length (months)
termDurationMonths.description: Term length in months (e.g. 48 for a 4-year term). Required, positive.

maxConsecutivePeriods.title: Max consecutive terms
maxConsecutivePeriods.description: Maximum number of consecutive terms. Optional: empty means unlimited. Drives the advisory (non-blocking, design D5) max-term warning on the rooster and on voordrachten.

notes.title: Note
notes.description: Free-text explanation of the rule (e.g. the statutory/verordening basis).

RoosterVanAftreden.title: RoosterVanAftreden
RoosterVanAftreden.description: One live rooster van aftreden (retirement schedule) object per governance body: a regeneratable projection (design D3), never hand-maintained truth. Carries generation metadata (gegenereerdOp/gegenereerdDoor) and the publication predicate for the rooster as a whole; the ordered term entries live as first-class RoosterRegel objects referencing this rooster. Publication is predicate-on-live-object (design D4) justified against public-publication's derived-payload rule because the rooster is ALREADY an allow-list projection (name, role, term number, term dates, herbenoembaar: never contact details, NC UIDs, addresses, or vote data). Setting publicationDate grants the public group read while publicationDate <= $now; clearing it withdraws.

body.title: Governance body
body.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this rooster van aftreden belongs to (one live rooster per body). Required.

generatedOn.title: Generated at
generatedOn.description: Timestamp of the most recent generation/regeneration. Shown prominently so a stale rooster is visibly stale, never silently wrong.

generatedBy.title: Generated by
generatedBy.description: Who triggered the most recent generation (griffie/secretary). Allow-list metadata only.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the live rooster and its regels are anonymously readable through the OR published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Opt-in per rooster; withdraw by clearing (design D4).

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the rooster is withdrawn from public access.

RoosterRegel.title: RoosterRegel
RoosterRegel.description: One first-class term entry (design D3) per active Membership under an effective TermijnRegeling, materialized on generation of its RoosterVanAftreden. Carries derived term data (termijnNummer, eindeTermijnDatum, herbenoembaar) computed by RoosterService:deriveTerm from Membership startDate/endDate history and the effective regeling (design D2), the derived values are materialized here, visible/auditable/regeneratable, never written onto the Membership schema. First-class (not an array on the rooster) so eindeTermijnDatum can drive declarative scheduled herbenoemingsrappels (x-openregister-notifications) and the expiring-terms KPI (widget aggregation over objects). persoonNaam is an allow-list projection field (no contact details / NC UIDs / vote data), so a published rooster exposes only name/role/term data.

subject.nl: Herbenoemingsrappel (6 maanden): termijn van {{persoonNaam}} ({{role}}) loopt af op {{eindeTermijnDatum}}
subject.en: Reappointment reminder (6 months): term of {{persoonNaam}} ({{role}}) ends on {{eindeTermijnDatum}}

herbenoemingsrappel6Maanden._note: Six-month herbenoemingsrappel (REQ-APT-010). intervalSec 15552000 (~6 months) is the default rappel window and is PROVISIONAL / griffie-configurable (design open question — per-body windows may move into TermijnRegeling with regeneration stamping the window onto the regel, see design Risks). Filter targets herbenoembaar regels; the 'eindeTermijnDatum enters the window' vs a plain interval is carried by OR's scheduled-notification window semantics, which the simple filter shape cannot express as a relative-date comparison on eindeTermijnDatum — VERIFY OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets these two triggers as 6/3-month before-term-end rappels during live import (same window-semantics caveat as the toezeggingen deadline rappels). Body/role are best surfaced via persoonNaam+role; the body name is not a direct field on the regel.

subject.nl: Herbenoemingsrappel (3 maanden): termijn van {{persoonNaam}} ({{role}}) loopt af op {{eindeTermijnDatum}}
subject.en: Reappointment reminder (3 months): term of {{persoonNaam}} ({{role}}) ends on {{eindeTermijnDatum}}

herbenoemingsrappel3Maanden._note: Three-month herbenoemingsrappel (REQ-APT-010). intervalSec 7776000 (~3 months) is the default second rappel window, PROVISIONAL / configurable. Same window-semantics caveat as herbenoemingsrappel6Maanden.

schedule.title: Rooster
schedule.description: Reference to the parent RoosterVanAftreden. Required.

membership.title: Membership
membership.description: Reference to the source Membership this regel was derived from (person-and-membership). Optional/nullable: a projection row may carry only the materialized persoonNaam when the Membership cannot be resolved at generation time (e.g. imported partial history).

personName.title: Member name
personName.description: Materialized member name (allow-list projection field; safe for public publication). Required.

role.title: Role
role.description: Membership role for this term entry (enum pinned to person-and-membership). Required.

termNumber.title: Term number
termNumber.description: Derived 1-based count of the person's consecutive terms in the same body-role. A reappointment without a gap increments; a gap or role change resets to 1. When it exceeds maxAansluitendeTermijnen an advisory warning is surfaced (non-blocking, design D5).

endTermDate.title: End-of-term date
endTermDate.description: Derived end-of-term date: start of the current term plus termijnDuurMaanden. Drives the declarative herbenoemingsrappels and the expiring-terms KPI, ordered ascending on the rooster. Required.

reappointable.title: Reappointable
reappointable.description: Derived from maxAansluitendeTermijnen: false when the current termijnNummer has reached the maximum consecutive terms, true otherwise (or when unlimited). Allow-list projection field.

rappelStatus.title: Reminder status
rappelStatus.description: Which herbenoemingsrappel windows have already fired for this regel (bookkeeping for the declarative rappels).
